title: Модальные глаголы в прошлом: must have / should have / could have / can't have

why: Модальный глагол + have + V3 позволяет комментировать прошлое: делать выводы («он, должно быть, забыл»), упрекать и сожалеть («надо было позвонить») и говорить об упущенных возможностях («мог бы помочь»). В русском это передаётся словами «должно быть», «надо было», «мог бы», а в английском всё это решает связка modal + have + V3.
formation: Формула: modal + have + V3 (третья форма глагола).
• must have + V3 — He must have forgotten.
• can't / couldn't have + V3 — She can't have said that.
• might / may / could have + V3 — They might have got lost.
• should / shouldn't have + V3 — You should have called.
В речи have сокращается: should've, could've, must've, might've. Вопрос: Should I have called him? Could he have known? Модальный глагол не меняется по лицам и не принимает to.
usage: 1. must have + V3 — почти уверены, что это было: The lights are off. They must have gone to bed. (Свет выключен. Они, должно быть, легли спать.)
2. can't have + V3 — почти уверены, что этого не было: He can't have seen me, he was abroad. (Он не мог меня видеть, он был за границей.)
3. might / may / could have + V3 — возможно, это было: She might have missed the bus. (Возможно, она опоздала на автобус.) Отрицание: He might not have heard you. (Возможно, он не услышал.)
4. should have + V3 — надо было сделать, но не сделали; shouldn't have — не надо было: You should have told me. I shouldn't have said that. (Тебе следовало мне сказать. Мне не стоило этого говорить.)
5. could have + V3 — была возможность, но не использовали: I could have helped you. (Я мог бы тебе помочь.)
signalWords: yesterday, last night, earlier, I'm sure, perhaps, maybe, it's impossible, why didn't you, but I didn't.
mistakes: ✗ You should told me. → ✓ You should have told me. (нужен have + V3)
✗ He must have forget it. → ✓ He must have forgotten it. (после have третья форма)
✗ She mustn't have been there. → ✓ She can't have been there. (для вывода «не может быть» используем can't have, а не mustn't have)
✗ I should to call him. → ✓ I should have called him. (после модального нет to)
✗ We could have went there. → ✓ We could have gone there. (go — went — gone)
remember: modal + have + V3 — это мнение о прошлом: вывод, упрёк или упущенный шанс.

items.prompt: He didn't come to the meeting. He ___ (must / forget) about it.
items.answer: must have forgotten

items.prompt: You were late again. You ___ (should / leave) earlier.
items.answer: should have left

items.prompt: She ___ (can't / see) me. She was in another city.
items.answer: can't have seen

items.prompt: I ___ (could / call) you, but I didn't have your number.
items.answer: could have called

items.prompt: He ___ (shouldn't / eat) so much cake. Now he feels sick.
items.answer: shouldn't have eaten

items.prompt: The door was open. Somebody ___ (must / come) in.
items.answer: must have come

items.prompt: They ___ (can't / win). They didn't even play well.
items.answer: can't have won

items.prompt: We ___ (could / miss) the train, but luckily we ran fast.
items.answer: could have missed

items.prompt: The lights are off. They (a) must have gone (b) must went (c) must have go to bed.
items.answer: (a) must have gone

items.prompt: You (a) should told (b) should have told (c) should had told me about the problem!
items.answer: (b) should have told

items.prompt: It's impossible. He (a) can't have said (b) mustn't have said (c) couldn't said that.
items.answer: (a) can't have said

items.prompt: I was lucky: I (a) could have lost (b) could lost (c) can have lost my wallet.
items.answer: (a) could have lost

items.prompt: She looks happy. She (a) must have passed (b) must pass (c) must has passed the exam.
items.answer: (a) must have passed

items.prompt: You (a) shouldn't have left (b) shouldn't left (c) mustn't have left your laptop in the car.
items.answer: (a) shouldn't have left

items.prompt: The test was easy. You (a) could have done (b) could had done (c) can have done better.
items.answer: (a) could have done

items.prompt: Why did you drive so fast? You (a) might have had (b) might had (c) might have has an accident.
items.answer: (a) might have had

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение с модальным глаголом в скобках

items.prompt: I'm sure she forgot her keys. (must)
items.answer: She must have forgotten her keys.

items.prompt: It was wrong of you to shout at him. (should)
items.answer: You shouldn't have shouted at him.

items.prompt: I'm sure he didn't take your phone. (can't)
items.answer: He can't have taken your phone.

items.prompt: It was a good idea to call her, but you didn't. (should)
items.answer: You should have called her.

items.prompt: Perhaps they got lost. (might)
items.answer: They might have got lost. / They might have gotten lost.

items.prompt: I'm sure it was a hard exam. (must)
items.answer: It must have been a hard exam.

items.prompt: It was possible for us to win, but we didn't. (could)
items.answer: We could have won.

items.prompt: I'm sure Anna didn't write this email. It's full of mistakes. (can't)
items.answer: Anna can't have written this email.

items.prompt: You should told me earlier.
items.answer: You should have told me earlier.

items.prompt: He must have forget his password.
items.answer: He must have forgotten his password.

items.prompt: Tom is so honest. He mustn't have lied to us.
items.answer: Tom is so honest. He can't have lied to us.

items.prompt: I should have went to the dentist.
items.answer: I should have gone to the dentist.

items.prompt: We should have took a taxi.
items.answer: We should have taken a taxi.

items.prompt: You shouldn't say that to her yesterday.
items.answer: You shouldn't have said that to her yesterday.

items.prompt: The keys must be have fallen out of my pocket.
items.answer: The keys must have fallen out of my pocket.

items.prompt: She could won the race, but she fell.
items.answer: She could have won the race, but she fell.

items.prompt: Тебе следовало позвонить мне раньше.
items.answer: You should have called me earlier.

items.prompt: Он, должно быть, забыл о встрече.
items.answer: He must have forgotten about the meeting.

items.prompt: Она не могла этого сказать.
items.answer: She can't have said that. / She couldn't have said that.

items.prompt: Мы могли бы успеть на поезд, но вышли слишком поздно.
items.answer: We could have caught the train, but we left too late.

items.prompt: Мне не стоило так много пить вчера.
items.answer: I shouldn't have drunk so much yesterday. / I shouldn't have had so much to drink yesterday.

items.prompt: Кто-то, должно быть, изменил пароль.
items.answer: Someone must have changed the password.

items.prompt: Ты мог бы помочь мне с этим багом!
items.answer: You could have helped me with this bug!

items.prompt: Возможно, они не получили моё письмо.
items.answer: They might not have received my email. / They may not have received my email.
